description: R9 derive-or-refute of a saturating/sub-additive/sign-changing shared-channel closure for the mixed multi-bond interface, on the t-ladder 7Li/11B/15N/19F (fixed light cluster = triton). Formalize-first interior-maximum invariant prunes the additive cone (P1) and the monotone-saturating 1-prod class (P2). Pre-registered candidates (a) 1-prod idempotent [excluded by P2], (c) resonance at k=A_light [reproduces peak + rising branch out-of-sample, fails the asymmetric fall], (b) parity/bar-graded [indicated missing term]. Closed-six regression: disjoint support, residuals unchanged. Scale V FITTED; b + deficits from committed witnesses; nothing recomputed, nothing wired.

interior_maximum_invariant.scope: excludes the additive-non-negative and monotone-saturating CLASSES given the committed AME deficits + all-alpha decompositions; excludes no ingredient (permanence)

candidate_a_1prod.verdict: EXCLUDED by P2 (monotone saturating cannot turn over; 19F over-predicted for every f)

candidate_c_resonance.verdict: PARTIAL — peak location + rising branch reproduced parameter-free, 15N out-of-sample +6.7%; 19F over-predicted +140% (symmetric parabola too shallow on the descending side); scale V FITTED

candidate_b_parity.verdict: INDICATED — even sublattice is a decaying sub-additive channel; odd k=3 enhanced above it; a bar-parity grading supplies the asymmetric fall (c) misses; not closed with one constant

verdict: PARTIAL / NEGATIVE (scope-(a)). FORMALIZE-FIRST (stated before the fit): the t-ladder Model-G miss has a strict INTERIOR MAXIMUM at k=3 (0 = M(1) < 6.440 < 8.049 > 2.679), which prunes TWO classes: (P1) the additive non-negative counting cone [R8, re-derived] and (P2, NEW) the entire MONOTONE-SATURATING 1-prod idempotent class 1-(1-f)^P(k) — it is non-decreasing in k for any f and cannot turn over, so task candidate (a) is EXCLUDED for the k=3->k=4 fall, not merely a bad fit. The surviving class is genuinely non-monotone. (c) RESONANCE at k=A_light: the parameter-free symmetric shape V*(k-1)(2*A_light-1-k) [peak at k=A_light=3 = the triton's nucleon count, zeros at k=1 (7Li closed) and k=5], scale V fitted on 11B, reproduces the peak LOCATION and the k=2->k=3 RISE and lands 15N out-of-sample to +6.7%; but it OVER-predicts 19F by +140% because the symmetric parabola is too shallow on the descending side. (b) PARITY: the even sublattice (11B k=2 -> 19F k=4) is itself a DECAYING sub-additive channel (2.679 < 6.440) and the odd k=3 peak sits +3.5 MeV above the even-neighbour mean — a bar-parity grading (even->Vol/mass, odd->decay) is INDICATED as the missing asymmetric term, connecting to the odd-Z pairing physics; it is not closed here with a single constant. CLOSED-SIX REGRESSION: the shared channel is gated on {A_light>=2 AND k>=2}; the closed six all fail the gate, so the term is identically 0 on them (disjoint support) and their committed Model-G residuals are UNCHANGED (all < 0.5% of B) — the strongest possible regression outcome. NO CONSTANT DERIVED: the resonance scale V and the parity split are FITTED / indicated, not derived; b and all deficits reused from committed witnesses; nothing wired.
